description:
Clean up a dataset by removing invalid records in gvSIG Desktop.

A shapefile named 'countries_cleaning.shp' has been loaded into the environment at '/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/countries_cleaning.shp'. This dataset contains several countries with invalid population data, marked with a Population Estimate (POP_EST) of -99.

Your task is to:
1. Load the 'countries_cleaning.shp' layer into a gvSIG View.
2. Start an editing session on the layer.
3. Identify and select ALL features where the 'POP_EST' field is equal to -99.
4. Delete these selected features.
5. Stop editing and save the changes to the shapefile.

The final shapefile should contain only valid countries (POP_EST != -99).
